units.source_text: 我在心里重复着这句话，却苦于不解其意。

en.t: I repeated those words in my heart, but I was troubled because I could not understand their meaning.

units.source_text: 一阵不安突然袭来，我想要继续往下看，这时听见哥哥从病房那边大声喊我。

en.t: A sudden wave of uneasiness came over me, and just as I tried to keep reading, I heard my brother calling loudly to me from the sickroom.

units.source_text: 我猛地一惊，赶紧站起身，快步穿过走廊，向众人守着的病房走去。

en.t: I started in alarm, quickly stood up, hurried down the corridor, and went toward the sickroom where everyone was keeping watch.

units.source_text: 我意识到父亲终于迎来了最后一刻。

en.t: I realized that my father had finally reached his last moment.
